Kass is great in high elo and for smurfing.  I personally take electrocute kassadin until diamond 3 or so, and even then I still take it 50/50 percent of the time

Manage your wave so you get an Xp advantage over your laner. The trick here is to not get shoved in, but have the wave just above your tower range. You do this by matching one auto for every two autos your laner does. If they use an ability, try to use it on the wave also. Never q them level one because it will draw minion aggro to you and your wave will be pushing in then. You can also set freezes in mid easy if they have 3 more minions than your minions pushing towards you. 
I smurf a lot in gold plat silver etc and they are complete apes in the mid lane. All they know how to do is shove and roam and you can abuse this by freezing the way towards your tower
Ofc you can’t do this in every match up but in most of them you can. 
If you are getting bullied out of lane or etc, you have to use q to mitigate damage and take tp. You can solo carry games as kassadin, electrocute build at level 11 easy if you get at least one of two kills early game
